FAQ.title: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.description: Everything you need to know about sending money home, paying with Zyra, and getting paid as a business.

q1.question: What is Zyra?
q1.answer: Zyra connects Africa and the diaspora. You can send euros from France, Canada or the US, pay bills, shops and services with a simple scan, save with a tontine, and, if you run a business, get paid by QR code.

q2.question: Who is Zyra for?
q2.answer: Anyone sending money to family in Africa, anyone receiving it, and businesses like restaurants, hotels and shops that want to accept payments easily.

q3.question: Do I need an account?
q3.answer: Yes. You sign up with your email and a password.

q4.question: When can I start using Zyra?
q4.answer: Zyra is currently in early access. Join the waitlist and we'll let you know as soon as your account is ready.

q1.question: Where can I send money?
q1.answer: To DR Congo, Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Cameroon, Kenya and Morocco. Your recipient receives the money in their local currency.

q2.question: Which countries can I send from?
q2.answer: France, Canada and the United States.

q3.question: How long does a transfer take?
q3.answer: Most transfers take just minutes. Timing can vary depending on the destination country and how you add your money.

q4.question: How much does it cost?
q4.answer: Transfers carry a 0.9% fee. You see the exact fee and the amount your recipient gets before you confirm.

q5.question: Is the exchange rate fair?
q5.answer: Zyra shows you the exchange rate and the exact amount your recipient will receive before you confirm, so you always know what you're getting.

q6.question: How do I add money?
q6.answer: By bank card (instant, 1.5% fee), by bank transfer (SEPA, free, about one business day), or by sending funds from another wallet (free).

q7.question: Is there a limit on how much I can send?
q7.answer: Limits may apply depending on your country and your verification level. The app shows the limits that apply to you.

q1.question: What can I pay for?
q1.answer: Bills, electricity (SNEL), rides (Yango), flights, hotels, online shopping, streaming subscriptions and more, directly from the app.

q2.question: How does paying by QR code work?
q2.answer: Open Zyra, tap Scan, and scan the merchant's QR code. Confirm the amount and you're done. When a merchant has an active payment ready, it also appears on your home screen so you can pay in one tap.

q3.question: What is a tontine?
q3.answer: A savings circle. Everyone contributes a set amount regularly, and each member takes a turn receiving the full pot. In Zyra you create the group, add members by phone number, Zyra ID or bank account, and payments happen inside the app.

q4.question: Can I talk to someone if I need help?
q4.answer: Yes. Tap the chat button on the home screen to message the team or ask the help assistant.

q1.question: How does my business accept payments?
q1.answer: Create a business account, choose your sector, and enter the amount to collect. Zyra shows a QR code for that payment, your customer scans it, and you're paid.

q2.question: What kinds of businesses can use Zyra?
q2.answer: Restaurants, cafés, bakeries, hotels, guesthouses, supermarkets, grocery stores, butchers and other shops.

q3.question: Can I track my sales?
q3.answer: Yes. Your dashboard shows sales for today, this week and this month, your customers and average basket, plus simple insights like your best day of the week.

q4.question: Can I download statements?
q4.answer: Yes. Daily, weekly, monthly and annual statements are available as PDF or spreadsheet (CSV).

q1.question: Is Zyra a bank?
q1.answer: No. Zyra is a financial technology company, not a bank. Payments and currency conversion are handled by licensed, regulated partners.

q2.question: Is my money safe?
q2.answer: Zyra works with licensed, regulated financial partners to handle payments, and uses identity checks to help protect accounts.

q3.question: Do you verify my identity?
q3.answer: Regulated financial services require it, so you may be asked to verify your identity, especially for larger amounts.

q4.question: How do I contact support?
q4.answer: Use the chat button in the app or the Contact page on our website.
